marines: Armoured and precise: walkers, gunships and orbital strikes. Win the sky, then land.
wooka: A furry horde that knows every fern: outnumber them, hide in the jungle, spring traps.
warLength: The short war is an evening, the full campaign several.
hotseatHint: Two players taking turns at this screen
onlineHint: Two players, a turn at a time, each from their own link
friendsHint: Open a party your eqosys friends join, then start the war together
friendsSignIn: Sign in with eqosys to play your friends

coach.title: Pick a side
coach.say: Thunder Marines or the Wooka, then the war, then Vs AI.

coach.title: Choose your fleet
coach.say: A preset, or your own mix of ships and armies.

coach.title: Place a unit
coach.say: Pick one of your worlds on the map, then + on its ships or an army.

coach.title: Deploy your fleet
coach.say: Deploy fleet, at the foot of the panel, once it stands where you want it.

coach.title: Call a play
coach.say: Step on to the Armada: where from, where to, how many, then Confirm.
